answers.expected_answer: Twelve ordinary turns: four seasons, each three ordinary rounds then a courtship. No player turn, rotation, monument reputation or Servants’ Hall use on courtship; only courtship resolves.

Rotate service; resolve round event then ongoing effects; choose activity; invite exact required gentry; provide service; enjoy favours; optional market buy; clear board. Used servants to Expended Service, played gentry to personal discard, tile upgraded if needed and returned to correct tableau column; last player advances marker.

All servants directly Available; all personal discard gentry to hand; round event then ongoing effects; choose £200 or free market refresh; optional one tile purchase; last player advances marker. Hiring on pass is expansion/optional and excluded here.

Legal if four needed servants are in Servants’ Quarters and costs payable. Service Help costs 3 increments each, Quarters to Available only. Screening reputation fixed after step 2 before step 3 is level 6 for tile and guests all turn; later loss does not invalidate.

All positive before all negative. Cannot take loss first at minimum; ignore only loss beyond minimum after positives. Must pay money penalty; activity income, VP money or Borrow Money can fund it. If unable to fund full payment cannot play guest.

Borrow £100 costs 2 increments, repeatable; Service Help 3 increments per servant Quarters to Available, repeatable; Refresh Market 4 increments, special action once per turn. Need enough reputation; no specials at minimum 1.1. No direct refresh from Expended via Service Help.

Use available butler/underbutler, no gentry. Take up to two from Servants for Hire except underbutler to Expended Service; used butler also expended and tile upgrades. Upgraded room may instead recruit one common footman/valet/lady’s maid from anywhere on one opponent board to your Expended, never unique servants.
Housekeeper only no available lady’s maid; footman requires Brushing Room and no available valet. Underbutler may replace butler/valet/footman even if regular available.
Only acquire Butler’s Pantry; gain underbutler from supply immediately into Expended Service. Cannot hire with Butler’s Room or hire-servant VP card; unique, cannot be recruited.
Market space price plus tile modifier; Reserve £300 plus modifier; minimum £100. Cannot acquire duplicates by any means. May purchase above reputation; PR restricts play only.

Slide remaining left; stack drawn duplicate on match and draw again; qualifying Service/PR1 drawn tile to Reserve and draw again; sort new tiles by ascending sorting number when filling multiple spaces. One remaining duplicate keeps space occupied so no refill.

After season1 all Service except Largest Wine Cellar; after season2 PR1. Later eligible draws go straight Reserve. Full Market refresh after first three courtships standard under compendium/corrigendum; old stable-market aid incomplete.

Return both Fairchilds first. Total current theme-category tile VP including negatives; highest draws VP and chooses one Fairchild to hand. Ties all draw VP and no Fairchild. Each discards one objective face down; shuffle together and bottom objective deck. At season setup first player passes anticlockwise.

Sum tile VP in all four revealed theme categories, repeated categories count repeatedly/double for two. Highest wins Fairchild+VP; tied highest reputation level breaks tie ignoring wheel position; if still tied no Fairchild, tied winners draw VP. After courtship final special actions and VP-card benefits if possible, then scoring.

Tiles including negative; gentry in hand/discard incl final Fairchild and negatives; remaining objectives; reputation 1,3,6,10,15,21,28 for levels1–7; servants2 each; £200 per1VP rounded down; unused VP cards. Tie: final Fairchild holder, then highest rep level ignoring position, then shared victory.

5 setup+2 Draw Objectives=7; discard1 each of4 courtships leaves3. Shuffle simultaneous face-down discards before bottom deck. Extra objective effects increase final total by1 each. Tile objectives require possession at end, no upgrade required.

Immediately on draw or anytime own turn; final chance after final courtship. Reveal and discard to bottom VP deck for benefit; may use several. Retain hidden with objectives and score printed VP if not discarded; no both benefit and VP.

First use normal tile flips to upgrade at cleanup, mandatory; upgraded stays. Hybrid flips each use and moves correct category, starts underlined hybrid icon side. Activity-to-monument flips after first use and never hosts again. Only currently face-up hybrid category counts.

After event in step2 hosting or step3 pass. Monuments1rep per ordinary turn, no courtship. Hall any one available servant on tile to lower opponent1 gain1; used servant expended end turn; still host activity/pass. Cannot target minimum-rep opponent.

Heritage one casual from hand, footman tile and guest normal service; double all favours including negative, stays upgraded activity. Queen one prestige from hand, housekeeper tile and normal guest service; double1 chosen favour others normal; upgrades monument. Lionheart butler tile draws1 prestige from deck no guest service, double all nonnegative favours, keep guest to discard; upgrades monument. All fixed1 cannot modify count.
